JADE from original BEYOND GOOD & EVIL (2003), adult Hillyan action-reporter. Exact primary-reference appearance: very short black swept/pixie-bob hair fully visible above a GREEN CLOTH HEADBAND across the forehead; no hat, cap or bonnet. Olive/tan skin, green eyes and green lipstick. Dark GREEN cropped jacket with rolled cuffs over a white cropped tank top, loose TEAL/GREEN trousers with darker swirl-pattern details, dark waist belt with reddish trim, brown practical sneakers, dark blue-black fingerless wrist gloves. Compact grey-blue camera with round lens and small red buttons, retractable blunt metallic Daï-Jo staff, Gyrodisk glove. No beige trousers, no boots or knee armour, no sword, no shield, no cape, no gun, no headwear over the black hair. Match the actual official2003 Steam screenshots supplied for appearance. Do not copy any screenshot pose or scenery. Draw new pixel-art motion.

Transparent RGBA pixel-art animation sheet, exactly FOUR COLUMNS by EIGHT ROWS, 32 separate complete adult bodies. PORTRAIT canvas with generous transparent outer margins and wide transparent gutters. Each physical ROW shows one named state and FOUR successive genuinely different articulated full-body drawings, left to right; all32 complete silhouettes and entire equipment fit inside the canvas and never touch another drawing. Same orthographic right-facing three-quarter side view and native pixel-art cluster style throughout; keep crouches/hangs/prone poses naturally lower, not stretched to standing height. No background, floor, ledge, shadow, caption, text, grid, labels, opponent or recycled/mirrored/rotated/translated duplicate. Complete heads, fingers, wrists, feet, camera and staff; extra-wide horizontal room for staff reach. Columns1and2 prepare, COLUMN3 is the contact/release pose for physical attacks, COLUMN4 recovers. Every row must be present, especially ROW8.

ROW 1, idle: Quiet grounded readiness; four different subtle breathing/weight/arm poses, staff collapsed and secured.
ROW 2, walk: Four successive rightward walking footfalls with alternating knees, feet and arms; staff collapsed and secured.
ROW 3, run: Four successive rightward running strides with different leg phases and swinging arms; staff collapsed and secured.
ROW 4, turn: Genuine four-pose body turn from left facing through rear-three-quarter to right facing; not mirrored copies.
ROW 5, jumpStart: Four progressive anticipation poses: bend knees, dip hips, compress ankles, then lift from takeoff; staff collapsed.
ROW 6, jumpRise: Four rising airborne body poses with changing knees and arm balance, complete shoes; staff collapsed.
ROW 7, jumpApex: Four physically different apex poses: one knee tuck, both knees tuck, opening one leg, extending both legs; staff collapsed.
ROW 8, fall: Four descending poses with gradually extended knees and changing arm balance; staff collapsed.
